Iran Embassy Video Taunts US Over Strait of Hormuz

Iran's embassy in Sierra Leone released an animated video challenging the United States to "come to Iran" over the Strait of Hormuz. The video, styled after the classic Minesweeper video game, was posted on Thursday amidst escalating tensions between the US and Iran. The embassy used the phrase 'Habibi, come to Iran' in its message.
